text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! All the people who cheered for
me have
great big smiles on their faces!
Everything's
buono! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? I'd like to hear your opinion,
too. What
did you think of my running
today?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay! You said I was buono! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'm happy you're smiling, too,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, the relief I get from seeing
you smile...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...It's gone and made me really hungry!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay! ☆ I'm going to eat a whole bunch
of food
and then do my best next time,
too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Does that mean I didn't do well
enough?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course I can! You just leave it to me,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, I'm itching to see what I can do! I'm going to make the whole venue into one big pot of smiling chanko!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono is brimming with
excitement and
more than ready to
tackle her next race!
